text: 你的无声挑衅至少让部分猎人颇为震动。一群人按住你，另一人从火堆旁端来一桶滚烫的油脂。如果被迫喝下，你冰冷的心脏必定会融化，你也将痛苦地死去。
黑暗的求生本能再次涌现。你奋力挣扎，想摆脱擒拿。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 285
text: Your silent taunt impressed at least some of the hunters. A group holds you, while one brings a vat of boiling fat from the cookfire. If forced to drink that, your icy heart will surely melt and you will die. It will be agonizing.
Your dark survival instinct resurges. You struggle against your captors.
